name: graph-uncertainty-scope
goal: Ignore only graph gaps proven unrelated to every active page during feature impact discovery

evidence: A Work component impact on 42c7 reports six dangling edges and 166 references. Five edges originate in tests and one is a scenario edge; every dangling edge currently makes all references block page discovery.

The existing scoped uncertainty matrix covers dangling unknown origins, but not a missing target reached only from an unrelated test or scenario versus the same gap reached from an active page. Extend that existing matrix without changing its case identity.

At 48e8fd191d the existing coverage matrix rejected a dangling test-only edge despite complete unrelated page reachability. Matched red record cb342fe9eca311cdd47d5ca5b594a01d449ef77f14a8d5a367adad2208c6e958.

At 469d28c255 only scenario edges and test/source gaps proven unreachable from active pages are excluded; missing page anchors, unknown origins, ambiguous nodes and page-reachable gaps remain blockers.

The unchanged coverage case passed in the same clean-snapshot environment; green record 3600305b65af2c0582008c9e214a63734315486746514edac3f81389e0cf80cd. Isolated mutations removing reachability or ownership checks each failed the matching assertion, and the restored test passed.
